audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] read 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: Two rows rendered two different answers. The packet chart (Vex 1-5, Aurelion Sol 6-7) matches the content layer at a 50.26% owner win rate over 392 games.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side set to Aurelion Sol.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Doom Gaze' is named as Vex's level 6 spike, and 'Comet of Legend' / 'Starsurge' / 'stacked stars' as Aurelion Sol's scaling.
audit.why: Vex's R is Shadow Surge (140/120/100, 2000/2500/3000 range, missile-then-dash recast); her passive is Doom 'n Gloom. 'Doom Gaze' does not exist. Aurelion Sol's kit is Stardust, Breath of Light, Astral Flight, the black hole and Falling Star / The Skies Descend — none of the old names exist either.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Shadow Surge opening from outside your 750-range beam; your scaling is stardust plus The Skies Descend.

audit.whatIsWrong: The fear is attributed to Personal Space (W) everywhere, and Mistral Bolt is described as punishing dashes.
audit.why: Doom 'n Gloom (P) is the fear: it periodically empowers her next basic ability to fear and interrupt dashes, and marks nearby dashers for bonus damage that shortens its own cooldown. Personal Space (W) is a 475-range shield plus nearby damage on 16/15/14/13/12 — it absorbs your burst rather than fearing. Mistral Bolt (Q) is a 1200-range accelerating missile with no dash punish of its own. The decisive interaction: Breath of Light and Astral Flight are interruptible channels, so an empowered basic ability ends either one — never start a beam while her passive is glowing. Her shield is the other one: force it out with a beam tick before committing Falling Star.
audit.corrected: Fear attributed to the passive; W treated as a shield to be drained; Q as a range advantage she holds over your 750.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns is a template and the packet flags zero sequencing advice anywhere on this matchup.
audit.why: Mistral Bolt 8/7/6/5/4, Personal Space 16/15/14/13/12, Looming Darkness flat 12s, Shadow Surge 140/120/100, Astral Flight 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with an explicit wait-for-the-passive-to-go-dark line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Astral Flight counts as a dash for Doom 'n Gloom's dash-mark is not resolvable from the kit files.
audit.why: Riot's text says the passive marks 'whenever a nearby enemy dashes' and Astral Flight is described as flight, not a dash. This is exactly the kind of eligibility question the kit files deliberately leave empty.
audit.corrected: Left unasserted on the page and raised as a question.

notes: 'Doom Gaze' is a fabricated ability — Vex's R is Shadow Surge and her passive is Doom 'n Gloom. The whole page also attributed the fear to Personal Space (W), which is a 475-range shield; the fear belongs to the passive. Content layer additionally described the pre-rework Aurelion Sol ('Comet of Legend', 'Starsurge', 'stacked stars', 'dash-reliant kit'); all rewritten. 'bonus true damage procs' on Mistral Bolt was also wrong — no true damage anywhere in her kit. phases[5].side/phases[6].side disagreed with win[5]/win[6] and were fixed. Whether Astral Flight counts as a dash for Doom 'n Gloom's mark and interrupt is not in Riot's text; left unasserted.
